Name: Gift Hint Chance in Daily Dialogue
Author: Breelier
Description:
Custom NPCs: Works for any NPC with a FriendsAndFamily list defined in Data/Characters. If an NPC doesn't have any family or friends, they just won't offer gift hints, even if you crank the chance up to 100%.  ¯⁠\⁠_⁠(⁠ツ⁠)⁠_⁠/⁠¯


[size=5]Installation Instructions[/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*](Optional) Install Generic Mod Config Menu.[/*]
[*]Download and extract this mod into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game![/*]
[/list]

Mods.DisplayName: Gift Hint Chance in Daily Dialogue

Manifest.Name: Gift Hint Chance in Daily Dialogue
Manifest.Description: Allows you to adjust or completely disable the chance of NPCs giving gift taste hints in daily dialogue. Changes the vanilla 2.5% chance to 0% by default.
Manifest.Author: Breelier
